title: The cemi field is the physical global workspace

statements.text: Neurons anywhere in the brain can read information that synchronously firing neurons put into the field, so the field acts as the brain's global workspace, and neuronal ignition events are the gateway into it.

sources.quote: The brain’s CEMI field thereby acts as the brain’s global workspace and is consistent with GWT.
it also provides a feasible physical substrate for the notions of working memory and/or the global workspace
